about.heading: About ELEVN
about.description: ELEVN is a platform powered by La Neta. We help creators grow faster, reach bigger audiences, and turn their content into real income. We work with over 50,000 creators across the Americas.

audienceBusiness.eyebrow: Already at 100K+? This is for you
audienceBusiness.lead: Brands already knock on your door. Your next jump is not another deal: it is turning your audience into income that does not depend on a single algorithm. We will build you a personalized Opportunity Kit, free.
audienceBusiness.bullet1: New markets: your same content earning in other languages.
audienceBusiness.bullet2: Income of your own: a course, product or membership that does not depend on brands.
audienceBusiness.bullet3: Expansion to new platforms so you never rely on one algorithm.
audienceBusiness.bullet4: Managed brand deals: you create, we close and manage.
audienceBusiness.formSub: On the call we show you, using your own numbers, the 3 fastest ways to diversify your income.
audienceBusiness.formDisclaimer: No strings attached. We reply within 24 hours.
audienceBusiness.successBody: We will reach out within 24 hours with your personalized Opportunity Kit.

faq.body: Anything else? Just reach out. We respond to every message.
faq.a1: ELEVN is a creator ecosystem where you'll find real brand opportunities, paid programs, courses, live events, and a community of creators from different verticals and regions. Apply once and get access to all of it.
faq.q2: Do I need a huge following to join?
faq.a2: No. ELEVN is built specifically for emerging and mid-sized creators. What matters is the quality of your content and your engagement. Not just the number on your profile.
faq.a3: Yes, joining ELEVN is completely free. You only go through a quick profile validation so we can match you with the right opportunities.
faq.q4: What kind of brands will I work with?
faq.a4: We partner with global brands like Dove, L'Oréal, Procter & Gamble, and many others, as well as platforms like Meta, Pinterest, YouTube, and Tubi. Every brand on ELEVN has been vetted by our team.
faq.q5: Do I keep ownership of my content?
faq.a5: Always. Every collaboration on ELEVN has clear terms that protect your rights. You own your content, your brand, and your audience.
faq.q6: How does ELEVN match me with campaigns?
faq.a6: Campaigns are matched based on your niche, content style, target audience, and brand fit—not just your follower count. The goal is to pair you with briefs where you can genuinely perform and build long-term relationships.
faq.q7: Which platforms does ELEVN focus on?
faq.a7: ELEVN is optimized for short-form and social video first: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and UGC-style content for paid media. Over time, we'll expand into more formats and platforms where creators can monetize.

finalCta.body: Join ELEVN and get access to brand deals, courses, events, and a community that actually supports your growth. It's free to apply.
